Grievance Redressal Mechanism
The college has a Grievance Redressal Cell to address the grievances of our students. The students access the cell to voice their grievances regarding academic matters, health services, library and other services. A Student may send his/her grievances to the principal through email
. The cell redresses the grievances by sorting out the problems promptly and judiciously.
The objective of the Grievance Cell is to develop a responsive and accountable attitude among all the students in order to maintain a harmonious educational atmosphere in our institute. The cell functions with the following objectives:
Upholding the dignity of the College by ensuring a strife-free atmosphere through promoting cordial

studentâstudent and studentâteacher relationships.

to remain anonymous can submit written grievances and suggestions for improving academics and administration.
Advising students to respect the rights and dignity of one another, and to show utmost restraint and patience
whenever any occasion of rift arises.

About Kings College of Engineering (Autonomous), a temple of learning.
Kings College of Engineering (Autonomous) is an institution which was formed with the single aim of providing quality education to the poor and underprivileged students. KCE is a NAAC accredited institution approved by All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi and is affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. The institution was established in the year 2001 on a sprawling campus of around 48 acres on the Thanjavur-Pudukkottai Highway and run by Raj Educational Trust (RET), Chennai, with a clear and concrete motive of spreading the wealth of knowledge. The institution offers 7 U.G and 4 P.G programmes. Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering & Department of Mechanical Engineering have Research Centres recognized by Anna University, Chennai.

Develop competent Civil Engineering professionals equipped with strong technical knowledge, practical skills, and ethical values to excel in public or private sector organizations and contribute meaningfully to society.

Address real-world infrastructure challenges by functioning as consultants, researchers, or entrepreneurs offering innovative, sustainable, and socially responsible solutions in areas such as housing, water supply, sewerage, transportation, and spatial planning.

Collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams and leverage modern tools, technologies, and policies to solve complex engineering problems, support infrastructure development, and promote continuous learning and professional growth.

Computer Science & Engineering
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) was established in the year 2001. It administers Bachelor's programme in Computer Science and Engineering and Master's programme in Computer Science and Engineering. The department is approved by AICTE, New Delhi and affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. The primary goal of CSE is to provide best IT infrastructure, world class learning & research environment, adopt industry practices through industry collaborations and inculcate moral and ethical values.

chunks.title: Kings College of Engineering (KCE)
chunks.text:
The Department has a pool of aptly qualified, veteran and readily accessible faculty members and state-of-the-art infrastructure with computing equipment supported by high speed Internet and wireless networks. The full-fledged labs expose students to a hands-on learning opportunity, assisting students to imbibe first-hand experience in various computer science arenas. The Department of CSE aims at providing inclusive technology education for its students under comfortable ambience. Graduates from the department are recruited by both academia and industry and few of them occupy top positions in both all over the world.
Importance is predominantly given to practical training on the emerging topics and special attention is bestowed on the project work of final year students.

chunks.title: Kings College of Engineering (KCE)
chunks.text:
Short term courses and technical lectures by eminent professors and corporate professionals are arranged on a regular basis to broaden the knowledge spectrum of students. The department regularly conducts workshop on various open source software offered by IIT Bombay in which our students participate and obtain certificates from IIT Bombay Spoken Tutorials. Various professional societies like IEI, ISTE are active throughout the year.
To become globally competent in the field of computing by imparting quality education, reinforcing social values and establishing the sense of technical exploration in the learners.
To impart knowledge in Computer Science and Engineering by means of appropriate teaching and learning methodologies in the knowledge seekers and make them socially responsible.

Instruments that control temperature are essential in many areas, including the electric power industry, the automobile industry, and the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) industry. The principles of thermal engineering are also crucial to the operation of vehicles and other machines.

Thermal engineers may be called upon to work in a number of different industries including the design of heating/cooling equipment, power management and optimization for power companies (gas, electric, nuclear etc) and also the development of renewable energies.
Energy conservation is a big issue in the modern world and thermal engineers are much sought after to work in a number of major industries from petrochemicals to renewable energies, and there is ample career prospects for anyone with an interest in engineering and environmental issues.
